description: Searches the Gemmein docs for one term or phrase ('keyed create', 'ifVersion', 'addressed', 'expand') without reading a whole document. Returns the docs site's matching sections first, best first — each a direct markdown link with its anchor (https://docs.gemmein.com/<page>.md#<section>) and its opening words, so one section is read, not a page — then the matching passages of the packaged guide and API reference with 3 lines of context either side, at most 6 match blocks per document. Offline: the section index ships with this server. Search finds what the docs say, not what Gemmein does not support; the fit assessment is in `guide`.
name: search_docs
title: Search docs
